picks.title: Astroburn expands into AI-powered animated vertical micro-series
picks.excerpt: HaZ Dulull turned his indie game Astroburn into ten one-minute vertical episodes on Nura's Showcraft, using a model locked to his own assets while keeping human voice actors and composers.
picks.rationale: A concrete, reproducible workflow for indie devs extending game IP into short-form video with AI assist and human authorship intact.

picks.title: Peak Devs Are Using Their Mountain Of Cash To Publish New Indie Games
picks.excerpt: Aggro Crab spun its Peak windfall into publishing arm Aggro Crab Presents, whose signing terms include 'And NO generative AI slop'.
picks.rationale: A publisher writing a no-genAI clause into its deal terms is a policy signal that lands directly on studio pipelines.

picks.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Cripples Most PCs in Modded Games, but DLSS 5 Autopilot Restores Playable Performance
picks.excerpt: DLSS 5 Autopilot runs Neural Rendering before the upscaler so Quality/Balanced/Performance modes work, and its DLSS5-Feeder injects DLSS 5 into any DX12, DX11 or DX10 game.
picks.rationale: Modders shipped the quality/perf tiering Nvidia hasn't, which changes what neural rendering costs in practice.

picks.title: Go grandmaster becomes first human to win series against advanced AI engine in 3-hour match
picks.excerpt: Shin Jin-seo took a three-game series 2-1 against KataGo on a two-stone handicap, and said imitating AI moves was what kept losing him games.
picks.rationale: The first human series win over a top engine, with a working lesson: copying the model's moves loses, playing your own board wins.

picks.title: Cosmic horror and sea bird waddling sim Penguin Colony gave me a genAI fright in its release date trailer
picks.excerpt: Penguin Colony's release date trailer flashes RTX, DLSS and genAI, then reveals them as Real Terror eXploration, Does Lovecraft Still Scare and GENeral Antarctic Isolation.
picks.rationale: A marketing gag that reads the industry's AI buzzword reflex back at it, and lands the Oct 8 date while doing it.
